value.cardTitle: Tracks A-E: Complete Dependabot Remediation (30 alerts closed), Remote MCP, CI Diagnostics, Canonical Supabase

Total repository advisories dropped from 31 down to 1 (0 open in pnpm-lock.yaml). Live MCP validated with 19/19 assertions; local quality gates (type-check, boundary scripts, vitest 30/30) 100% clean.
